column6: Historically matured only in sherry-seasoned oak from Jerez; today's range (Triple Cask/Double Cask) also uses bourbon casks, so "baseline" rather than "require".
Aged in sherry casks made of either American or European oak, purchased from Oloroso sherry producers in Spain per Wikipedia.
scotchwhisky.com tasting-note summary lists "honey" among the current blend's flavours.
Same source lists "floral and oak aromas" for the current blend.
